name: bbob-largescale (COCO) test suite
description:
The bbob-largescale test suite, containing 24 single-objective functions in
continuous domain, extends the well-known single-objective noiseless bbob test
suite, which has been used since 2009 in the BBOB workshop series, to large
dimension. The core idea is to make the rotational transformations R, Q in
search space that appear in the bbob test suite computationally cheaper while
retaining some desired properties. This documentation presents an approach that
replaces a full rotational transformation with a combination of a
block-diagonal matrix and two permutation matrices in order to construct test
functions whose computational and memory costs scale linearly in the dimension
of the problem.
evaluation_method: expected running time (ERT) / number of function evaluations to reach target(s); success rate over runs
general_score_metric: Expected Running Time (ERT) / function evaluations to reach predefined target values
reputation: Long-standing, widely used benchmark in the continuous optimization community (BBOB workshop series) for comparing black-box optimizers at large scale.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark consisting of synthetic test functions scalable to high dimension; evaluation depends on chosen targets and budgets; computationally expensive at large dimensions but reproducible; not saturated.
